submit_repoprover_slurm_job: submit a SLURM job to run RepoProver on a Lean project with configurable pool size and node count
copy_repoprover_code: copy the repoprover code snapshot to a run directory using rsync with allowlisted subdirectories
link_lean_project: create a symlink to a Lean formalization project directory to avoid slow copying of .lake and .git
validate_stool_args: validate and transform StoolArgs including resolving project paths, output directories, and SLURM partition time
get_partition_max_time: query sinfo to get the maximum time limit in minutes for a given SLURM partition
